info.note: Sale lists include amounts due. The excess funds list includes purchase price and buyer.

auction.time: First Tuesday of the sale month. For the September 1, 2026 sale, registration began at 8:30 am and the sale started at 10:00 am.
auction.registration: Complete the Bidder Registration form posted on the Tax Sales page (name, address, phone, email, driver's license number). Bring it on the day of the sale or email it to d.cruse@meriwethercountyga.gov. The form must be filled out in its entirety.
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds are required. The bid must be paid on the day of the sale or the purchaser faces a judgment for the bid amount.
auction.office_address: 17234 Roosevelt Highway, Building A, Greenville, GA 30222 (mailing: PO Box 729, Greenville, GA 30222)
vital: All sales are final. The taxing authority makes no claims or guarantees about any property or mobile home sold.
Failure to pay the bid price on the day of the sale results in a judgment against the purchaser for the bid amount.
Sale lists include real property and mobile homes, show the total due per parcel and link to qPublic. Lists are reissued as owners pay.

Georgia law: the owner or any lienholder may redeem for 12 months after the sale, and until the right to redeem is foreclosed, by paying the bid plus a 20% premium, plus 10% for each additional year (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45).
The sale location is not stated on the Tax Commissioner site. Call the office to confirm where to go.
auction.confirmed: Checked 2026-10-03. Latest posted list is for the September 1, 2026 sale (PDF created 2026-08-31). The 8:30 am registration and 10:00 am start come from the September 2026 home page notice, since removed from the live page.
